title: Generation of stem/progenitor cultures from mouse lungs
protocol: Mechanical disruption of mice lungs passing the homogenates through a 70 μm strainer to obtain single cells.
Plate the cells in DMEM supplemented with 20% FBS and 30 μg/ml Insulin.
Incubate at 37°C in a 5% CO₂ atmosphere.
After 4 hours, add FibrOutTM to eliminate fibroblasts.
Keep the cells under these conditions for 2 weeks, changing the media every 3 days and splitting them when needed.
Change the cells to serum-free DMEM supplemented with FGF (10 ng/ml) and EGF (20 ng/ml).
After 2 or 3 weeks, analyze the resulting cell population by flow cytometry.
Fix an aliquot of these cells, permeabilize them, and label with SPC and CC-10 antibodies to confirm the percentage of double positive cells (SPC+/CC10+).
Sort the remaining cells for Sca-1+/CD45−/PECAM− using a FACS Aria cytometer.
After re-plating, maintain the sorted cells in serum-free media plus FGF and EGF.
Analyze an aliquot of these cells again by flow cytometry to confirm they are SPC+/CC10+.
The final population in culture should be SP-C+/CC-10+/Sca1+/CD45−/PECAM−.
Mix serial dilutions of the cells with plating medium for 96 well plates.
Plate diluted cells to obtain wells with single cells.
Expand six isolated clones in serum-free media.
Test expanded clones for differentiation potential.
Maintain stem/progenitor cells in serum-free media, noting aggregation tendency.
Culture cells in the presence of 20% FBS to form single cell layers and initiate differentiation.
